title: Young Hitler and Lanz von Liebenfels's Order of the New Templars

tellings.quote: It said that he actually visited Lans van Libfels in his office.

plain: In Vienna around 1900 to 1903, a young Adolf Hitler is said to have visited Lanz von Liebenfels, a mystic who founded a secretive group called the Order of the New Templars, in his office. The researcher and author Peter Levenda tells Michels this from a source he does not name ("It said that he actually visited" him), and it ties to his book Unholy Alliance. If true, it would link Hitler early on to the occult circles of Vienna.
